faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about ordering, payment, and delivery.
faq.q1Question: How do I place an order?
faq.q1Answer: Browse products, add items to your cart, then complete checkout with your contact and shipping details. You can pay with KBZ Pay using Full Payment (100% upfront) or Half Payment (50% deposit, remainder to the courier on delivery).
faq.q2Question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.q2Answer: We currently accept KBZ Pay Full Payment and Half Payment (50% deposit). We do not offer standard Cash on Delivery. For KBZ Pay, scan the QR code and upload your payment proof at checkout.
faq.q3Question: How can I track my order?
faq.q3Answer: Use Track Order in the header or footer and enter the tracking number from your confirmation. You can also find it in your account order history when signed in.
faq.q4Answer: Orders over 50,000 MMK qualify for free shipping. Smaller orders include a standard delivery fee shown at checkout.
faq.q5Question: Can I get a discount code?
faq.q5Answer: Yes — enter a promo code in the Order Summary at checkout when available. Follow us on WhatsApp for seasonal offers.
